create.name: Dr. Roxanne Partridge
create.bio:
Dr. Roxanne Partridge is a depth psychologist and ritual artist who studied at Pacifica Graduate Institute, earning both a master's degree and a doctorate in the field. She is also a clinical hypnotherapist and a practitioner of the 4D Wheel, the framework for erotic and sexual wholeness developed by Gina Ogden. Through her practice, embodyperiod., she works with women on desire, sexuality, the menstrual cycle, creativity and life transitions, treating these as matters of soul to be listened to rather than problems to be solved.

Her methods draw on archetypal psychology, myth and symbol, active imagination, movement, shamanic journeying and arts-based ritual, and she often frames a woman's growth through stories such as Inanna's descent to the underworld and return. She mentors women online through Seasonal Alchemy, a programme that runs from one solstice or equinox to the next and can continue for one, two or four seasons, and she offers a free Soul Map Reading quiz as an easy first step. She has led in-person retreats at Omega Institute and Kripalu, where her November 2026 weekend uses the 4D Wheel and the phases of Jungian alchemy to explore eros as a source of creative power.

courses.title: Unlocking Eros: Reclaim Your Healing and Creative Power
courses.description: A residential weekend at Kripalu for women on the erotic as a wider current of aliveness, not only sexuality. Gina Ogden's 4D Wheel guides the group through the four stages of Jungian alchemy, with arts-based ritual, shamanic journeying, work with two personal objects and embodied movement.

courses.title: Seasonal Alchemy Soulwork Mentorship
courses.description: An online mentorship, joined by application, for women whose work or calling is creative, timed to the solstices and equinoxes. Each 13-week season opens and closes with a ceremony call and includes weekly mentoring calls, ritual guidance, an online portal and message support, and women can sign up for one, two or four seasons.

free_resources.title: Soul Map Reading
free_resources.description: A free online quiz that suggests which part of a woman's inner compass is steering her life at the moment. It is based on archetypes and ritual and points to a next step.

sprint.tier_evidence: Instagram 14K (@embodyperiod og:description, 1 Nov 2026); no YouTube channel of her own found; no other public accounts linked from her site → ~14k total → local_hero
flags: No email and no message form: her contact page offers Acuity booking links (free discovery call, consultation, and a free Zoom 'coffee date' for podcast and speaking enquiries), used here as the contact route; a human may want to confirm a booking page is acceptable.

Her one-to-one Embody You sessions are framed as a 'therapeutic container' and sold partly on PMS/PMDD and sexual or reproductive trauma, so they are left out; her other work (mentorship, ritual retreats) is soulwork rather than therapy, but she is a depth psychologist and clinical hypnotherapist, so worth a human check against the 'mainly therapy' rule.
Her own page for the Kripalu weekend says it is for women reconnecting to desire after trauma or burnout; the Kripalu programme page itself names no condition, and the description here avoids it.

Both videos are on other channels (Kripalu, Candice Wu's podcast), with her as the main speaker; the podcast episode is about the menstrual cycle as a window on the psyche, which is not framed as a condition but is a borderline topic.
A third-party listing places her in Hudson, New York, but her own site does not say where she sees people, so availability is set to worldwide.
Only one photo used (Kripalu headshot); her site's images could not be tied to her by file name.
